description: Reference token counts for EstimatedTokenCounterTests. The counts come from a real tokenizer and were recorded once; the estimator under test did not produce them.
method: referenceTokens is the token count of one chat message: 3 tokens of message framing, plus the tokens of the role name, plus the tokens of each string the message carries.

A text or custom segment carries its content. A toolResult segment carries its tool call ID and its content. A toolUse segment carries its tool call ID, the word 'function', its tool name, and its content.

Text messages follow the per-message formula OpenAI publishes for chat completions. For tool calls and tool results the same formula is applied to the fields the request carries; a provider's own framing of tool calls is not published, so those counts are approximate by a few tokens per message.
To record again: for every sample, encode each of those strings with the tokenizer named above, add the lengths, add 3, and write the sum to referenceTokens.
toleranceRules: under and over are fractions of referenceTokens. An estimate may be at most 'under' below the reference and at most 'over' above it.
Each bound is the largest error measured for the kind when the counts were recorded, rounded up to the next 0.05. errorWhenRecorded keeps that measured range, lowest sample to highest sample.
over is null where the estimate ran more than 15% above the reference. For those kinds only the lower bound is checked, and the upper bound to accept is an open decision.
JSON with whitespace is checked on the lower bound only, because an estimate above the reference is the safe direction and tab indentation runs up to about 21% high.

prose.covers: English prose, chat text and Markdown sent as message text.

source-code.covers: Rust, C#, Python, TypeScript, SQL and shell source sent as message text.

json.covers: Compact JSON, with no whitespace between its tokens, sent as message text.

json-whitespace.covers: JSON with whitespace between its tokens: indented with spaces or tabs, spaced on one line, sent as a tool result, or inside prose.

tool-output.covers: Tool results: logs, listings, search hits, tables, terminal escapes, file text and compact JSON.

tool-call.covers: Model messages that call a tool, with JSON arguments.

non-latin.covers: Cyrillic, Japanese, Chinese, Korean, Arabic, Hebrew and mixed-script text.

segments.content:
A context window is the amount of text a model can read in one request. In a long agent loop the conversation doesn't stay small: every tool call adds a result, and each result is sent again on the next request. After 40 or 50 turns it's common to see 120,000 tokens of history, most of it stale.

There are three ways to deal with that. The first is to drop old messages, which is cheap but loses the user's original request. The second is to replace old tool results with a short placeholder; the model can't read them any more, but it can call the tool again. The third is to ask a model for a summary, which costs a request and isn't free of mistakes either. We'll usually combine all three, and that's what this library does.

None of these works without a token count that you can trust. A provider's tokenizer isn't available offline, so we estimate, and the estimate has to be checked against something that wasn't written by the same author. See https://platform.openai.com/tokenizer for a quick manual check, or www.example.org/docs/tokens for background.

-- Orders per customer for the last 30 days, with the share of refunded orders.
SELECT c.customer_id,
       c.email,
       COUNT(o.order_id)                                   AS orders,
       SUM(o.total_cents) / 100.0                          AS revenue,
       ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN o.status = 'refunded' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END), 3) AS refund_share
FROM customers AS c
LEFT JOIN orders AS o
       ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
      AND o.created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.email
HAVING COUNT(o.order_id) > 0
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 50;

Контекстное окно — это объём текста, который модель может прочитать за один запрос. В длинном цикле агента разговор быстро растёт: каждый вызов инструмента добавляет результат, и этот результат отправляется снова при следующем запросе. Через сорок или пятьдесят шагов история часто занимает больше ста тысяч токенов, и большая её часть уже не нужна.

Поэтому старые результаты инструментов заменяются короткой заглушкой, а более ранние сообщения сжимаются в краткое резюме. Закреплённые сообщения, например системная инструкция, не изменяются никогда.

コンテキストウィンドウとは、モデルが一度のリクエストで読み取れるテキストの量のことです。エージェントのループが長くなると、会話はすぐに大きくなります。ツールを呼び出すたびに結果が追加され、その結果は次のリクエストでもう一度送信されます。

そのため、古いツールの結果は短いプレースホルダーに置き換えられ、さらに古いメッセージは要約にまとめられます。システムプロンプトのような固定されたメッセージは変更されません。APIキーの設定とWi-Fi接続の確認もお忘れなく。

上下文窗口是模型在一次请求中可以读取的文本量。在较长的代理循环中，对话会迅速增长：每次调用工具都会增加一个结果，而这个结果会在下一次请求时再次发送。
